partialTotal.explanation: Partial total: {count, plural, one {# amount} other {# amounts}} could not be included, so the figure shown excludes them. No rate to {displayCurrency} is available for {currencies}.
partialTotal.explanationExcluded: Partial total: {count, plural, one {# amount} other {# amounts}} could not be worked out, so the figure shown excludes them.

unknownAmount.scheduledFx: The current amount cannot be worked out: no exchange rate is available for this scheduled item's settlement currency pair. The stored amount was calculated at an older rate, so it is not shown.
unknownAmount.displayFx: This figure cannot be shown here: the amount is known, but no exchange rate is available to convert it into the currency this total is reported in. Refresh your rates on the Currencies page.
unknownAmount.noCashBalance: This value cannot be worked out: a cash account in this view reported no balance for this day, so what it held is unknown rather than zero. Reload the report; if it persists, the day's balances could not be worked out and this is worth reporting.
unknownAmount.noPrice: This value cannot be worked out: the shares held are known, but the security has no price to value them at. Refresh prices, or add one by hand on the security's Price history.
unknownAmount.noBaseline: This figure cannot be worked out: it is a comparison, and there is no earlier value to measure it against. Nothing is missing, so there is nothing to add.
unknownAmount.staleQuote: The day's move cannot be worked out: the security's most recent price is older than the last trading session, so any change from it would be an earlier day's. Refresh prices, or check the security's quote provider.
unknownAmount.unknownCurrency: This amount cannot be shown: the record names no security, so the currency the figure is in is unknown. Open the transaction and give it a security so its amounts can be labelled.

scheduledOverdue.included: Includes {count, plural, one {# overdue scheduled transaction} other {# overdue scheduled transactions}}
